name: Perceived Walkability in London: Four Ratings and Personality
description:
Method replication: participants answer demographic questions and a 10-item personality inventory, rate 15 London street views on four statements (I would enjoy walking in this area; I would feel safe walking in this area; I find this area beautiful; I find this area socially vibrant; 1–5 from strongly disagree to strongly agree), then say whether ten kinds of objects make an area more or less walkable; the images are not the survey's stimuli (92 Google Street View images from across London, 2019–2026).

Original study: perceived walkability survey by Novack, Tripp & Cámara Menoyo, University of Warwick (project "Walkability Perception and its Relations to Scenery Elements and Socio-Demographics"), run in Qualtrics from February to April 2022; 1,440 respondents each rated 15 images drawn from 495 London street view images grouped in five clusters (three per cluster). The anonymised responses and 86,400 ratings are open on Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.18619779, CC BY-SA 4.0).

Differences from the original study: (1) newly fetched Google Street View images instead of the 495 original images, which are not released; (2) 15 images drawn at random rather than three from each of five image clusters; (3) the demographic block is shortened (ethnicity, sexual orientation, education, marital status, carer and employment questions left out); (4) answer options follow the labels in the released data, but question wording outside the released variable descriptions is paraphrased.
author: Novack, Tripp & Cámara Menoyo

main{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.4rem;margin:0 0 6px}p{margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:18px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 18px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent)}
.btn.opt{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:500;padding:10px 6px;line-height:1.25}
.btn.opt:hover,.btn.opt:focus-visible{border-color:var(--accent)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.progress{height:6px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0 12px}.progress>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent)}
.pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.pick{position:relative;border:3px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;padding:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:3/2}
.pick img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:9px;background:#000}
.pick:focus-visible,.pick:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.pick span{position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:.85rem}
.tie{margin-top:12px;width:100%}
.shot{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;max-height:60vh;object-fit:contain;display:block;border-radius:8px;background:#000}
.scale{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--n),1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:14px}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
label.o{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer}
input.t{width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;font:inherit;margin-top:6px}
.q{margin-top:14px}.q>b{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.rng{accent-color:var(--accent)}.lks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--n),1fr);gap:6px;margin:6px 0 2px}.lk{appearance:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 0;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.lk[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}.q{margin-top:10px}.err{color:#b3261e;margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:620px){.pair{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}.pick{aspect-ratio:16/9}.scale{grid-template-columns:1fr}.scale.num{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}h1{font-size:1.2rem}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="app" aria-live="polite"><p>Loading…</p></main>
<footer class="credit">Street images: London, Google Street View (© Google). Questions from the perceived walkability survey of Novack, Tripp & Cámara Menoyo, University of Warwick (2022), data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.18619779 (CC BY-SA 4.0).</footer>
<script>
(function(){
  var C={"before": ["gender", "age", "modes_transport_walking", "mobility_disabilities", "personality_1_extraverted_enthusiastic", "personality_2_critical_quarrelsome", "personality_3_dependable_self_disciplined", "personality_4_anxious_easily_upset", "personality_5_open_to_new_exp_complex", "personality_6_reserved_quiet", "personality_7_sympathetic_warm", "personality_8_disorganized_careless", "personality_9_calm_emotionally_stable", "personality_10_conventional_uncreative", "living_london", "local_knowledge_london"], "after": ["influencing_objects_window_shop", "influencing_objects_persons", "influencing_objects_vehicles", "influencing_objects_sky", "influencing_objects_greenery", "influencing_objects_traffic_object", "influencing_objects_barriers", "influencing_objects_street_lights", "influencing_objects_stairs", "influencing_objects_tables_and_chairs", "influencing_positive_objects", "influencing_negative_objects"], "tasks": ["walkability"], "minutes": 15, "alt": "Street view in London", "labels": {}, "buttons": ["walkability"], "minSec": {}, "words": {"walkability": {"enjoyment": ["Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neutral", "Agree", "Strongly agree"], "safety": ["Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neutral", "Agree", "Strongly agree"], "aesthetics": ["Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neutral", "Agree", "Strongly agree"], "vibrancy": ["Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neutral", "Agree", "Strongly agree"]}}, "captions": {}, "pickOne": null, "heading": "Would you like to walk here?", "intro": "<p>This survey asks what makes an area seem more or less walkable. First a few questions about you and a short personality inventory, then you rate <b>15 street views from London</b> on four statements, and finally a few questions about what influences your ratings. About 15 minutes.</p>"};
  var app=document.getElementById('app'),A={},tasks=[],ti=0,i=0,done={};
  function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c];});}
  function err(m){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e)e.textContent=m||'';}
  function Q(n){return SPSite.getQuestion(n);}
  function trialsOf(n){var p=A[n];return p&&Array.isArray(p.trials)?p.trials:(Array.isArray(p)?p:[]);}
  function filled(n){var v=A[n];return v!=null&&v!==''&&!(Array.isArray(v)&&!v.length);}
  function nextStep(){
    for(;ti<tasks.length;ti++){var q=Q(tasks[ti]);for(i=0;i<q.trialCount;i++){if(!(done[tasks[ti]]||{})[i])return trial();}}
    return about();
  }
  function form(names,label,after){
    var h='<h1>'+esc(label)+'</h1><div class="card">';
    names.forEach(function(n){var q=Q(n);if(!q)return;
      if(q.type==='text'||q.type==='comment'){h+='<div class="q"><b>'+esc(q.title)+'</b><input class="t" name="'+n+'" value="'+esc(A[n]||'')+'"></div>';}
      else{var multi=q.type==='checkbox';h+='<div class="q"><b>'+esc(q.title)+'</b>'+(q.choices||[]).map(function(c){var v=c.value!=null?c.value:c;var t=c.text!=null?c.text:c;
        var on=multi?(A[n]||[]).indexOf(v)>=0:A[n]===v;return '<label class="o"><input type="'+(multi?'checkbox':'radio')+'" name="'+n+'" value="'+esc(v)+'"'+(on?' checked':'')+'> '+esc(t)+'</label>';}).join('')+'</div>';}
    });
    app.innerHTML=h+'<div class="row"><button class="btn" id="go">Continue</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    names.forEach(function(n){app.querySelectorAll('[name="'+n+'"]').forEach(function(el){el.onchange=function(){
      var q=Q(n),v;if(q.type==='checkbox'){v=[].map.call(app.querySelectorAll('[name="'+n+'"]:checked'),function(x){return x.value;});}else v=el.value;
      A[n]=v;SPSite.answer(n,v).then(function(r){if(r&&r.ok===false)err(r.error);});};});});
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){var miss=names.filter(function(n){var q=Q(n);return q&&(q.required||q.isRequired)&&!filled(n);});
      if(miss.length)return err('Please answer: '+miss.map(function(n){return Q(n).title;}).join('; '));after();};
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
  }
  function intro(){
    var c=Q('consent');
    app.innerHTML='<h1>'+C.heading+'</h1>'+C.intro+'<p>It takes about '+C.minutes+' minutes. There are no right or wrong answers.</p>'+
      '<div class="card"><p>'+esc(c.title)+'</p><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="yes">'+esc(c.labelTrue||'I agree')+'</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('yes').onclick=function(){SPSite.answer('consent',true).then(function(r){if(r&&r.ok===false)return err(r.error);A.consent=true;start();});};
  }
  function start(){
    if(C.pickOne&&!filled(C.pickOne.name)){var k=Math.floor(Math.random()*C.pickOne.values.length);A[C.pickOne.name]=C.pickOne.values[k];SPSite.answer(C.pickOne.name,A[C.pickOne.name]);}
    if(C.pickOne){var g=C.pickOne.groups[C.pickOne.values.indexOf(A[C.pickOne.name])]||C.pickOne.groups[0];tasks=C.tasks.filter(function(n){return g.indexOf(n)>=0;});}else tasks=C.tasks.slice();
    ti=0;
    if(C.before.length&&C.before.some(function(n){var q=Q(n);return q&&(q.required||q.isRequired)&&!filled(n);}))return form(C.before,'About you',nextStep);
    nextStep();
  }
  function trial(){
    var n=tasks[ti],q=Q(n),t=(q.trials&&q.trials[i])||{},md=t.media||q.media||[],k=i;
    var head='<h1>'+esc(q.title)+'</h1>'+(q.description?'<p>'+esc(q.description)+'</p>':'')+'<p>'+(q.type==='imagepicker'?'Pair ':'Image ')+(i+1)+' of '+q.trialCount+(tasks.length>1?' · part '+(ti+1)+' of '+tasks.length:'')+'</p>'+
      '<div class="progress" aria-hidden="true"><i style="width:'+(100*i/q.trialCount)+'%"></i></div>';
    var h=head;
    if(q.type==='imagepicker'){
      var ch=t.choices||q.choices||[],imgs=ch.filter(function(c){return !c.tie;}),tie=ch.find(function(c){return c.tie;});
      h+='<div class="pair">';imgs.forEach(function(c,j){var src=c.imageUrl||(md[j]&&md[j].url)||'';var L=String.fromCharCode(65+j);
        h+='<button class="pick" data-v="'+esc(c.value)+'" aria-label="Choose '+L+'"><img src="'+esc(src)+'" alt="'+esc(C.alt)+' '+L+'"><span>'+L+'</span></button>';});
      h+='</div>'+(tie?'<button class="btn ghost tie" data-v="'+esc(tie.value)+'">'+esc(tie.text)+'</button>':'');
    }else if(q.kind==='sliders'||/slidergroup$/.test(q.type)){
      h+='<img class="shot" style="max-height:'+((q.dimensions||[]).length>4?'32vh;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2':(q.dimensions||[]).length>2?'40vh':'56vh')+'" src="'+esc((md[0]&&md[0].url)||'')+'" alt="'+esc(C.alt)+'">';
      var cu=(md[0]&&md[0].url)||'',cap=Object.keys(C.captions||{}).filter(function(x){return cu.indexOf(x)>=0;})[0];
      if(cap)h+='<p style="margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--ink)">'+C.captions[cap]+'</p>';
      var BT=(C.buttons||[]).indexOf(n)>=0,W=(C.words||{})[n]||{};
      if(BT)(q.dimensions||[]).forEach(function(d){var b='';for(var v=d.min;v<=d.max;v+=(d.step||1))b+='<button type="button" class="lk" data-d="'+esc(d.id)+'" data-val="'+v+'">'+esc(W[d.id]?W[d.id][v-d.min]:v)+'</button>';
        h+='<div class="q"><b>'+esc(d.label)+'</b><div class="lks" style="--n:'+Math.round((d.max-d.min)/(d.step||1)+1)+'">'+b+'</div><p style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:0;font-size:.85rem"><span>'+esc(d.left)+'</span><span>'+esc(d.right)+'</span></p></div>';});
      else (q.dimensions||[]).forEach(function(d){h+='<div class="q"><b>'+esc(d.label)+': <span id="v_'+esc(d.id)+'">–</span></b><input type="range" class="rng" data-d="'+esc(d.id)+'" min="'+d.min+'" max="'+d.max+'" step="'+(d.step||1)+'" value="'+Math.round((d.min+d.max)/2)+'" style="width:100%"><p style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:0"><span>'+esc(d.left)+'</span><span>'+esc(d.right)+'</span></p></div>';});
      h+='<div class="row"><button class="btn" id="next" disabled>Next</button></div><p style="font-size:.85rem">'+(BT?'Answer every line to continue.':'Move the slider to give your answer.')+'</p>';
      app.innerHTML=h+'<div class="err"></div>';
      var vals={},rs=app.querySelectorAll('.rng'),nx=document.getElementById('next');
      var MS=(C.minSec||{})[n]||0,t0=Date.now(),okT=!MS;
      function gate(){nx.disabled=!(okT&&Object.keys(vals).length>=(q.dimensions||[]).length);}
      if(MS){var tm=document.createElement('p');tm.className='tmr';tm.style.fontWeight='600';nx.parentNode.parentNode.insertBefore(tm,nx.parentNode);
        var iv=setInterval(function(){var left=Math.ceil(MS-(Date.now()-t0)/1000);if(!document.body.contains(tm)){clearInterval(iv);return;}
          if(left>0)tm.textContent='Please keep looking: '+left+' s';else{tm.textContent='';okT=true;clearInterval(iv);gate();}},250);}
      if(BT){var nd=(q.dimensions||[]).length;app.querySelectorAll('.lk').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){var d=b.getAttribute('data-d');vals[d]=Number(b.getAttribute('data-val'));
        app.querySelectorAll('.lk[data-d="'+d+'"]').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',x===b?'true':'false');});gate();};});}
      rs.forEach(function(r){r.oninput=function(){vals[r.getAttribute('data-d')]=Number(r.value);document.getElementById('v_'+r.getAttribute('data-d')).textContent=r.value;gate();};});
      nx.onclick=function(){nx.disabled=true;SPSite.answer(n,vals,{trial:k}).then(function(r){if(r&&r.ok===false){err(r.error);nx.disabled=false;return;}(done[n]=done[n]||{})[k]=true;nextStep();});};
      window.scrollTo(0,0);return;
    }else{
      var lo=q.rateMin||1,hi=q.rateMax||5,lab=C.labels[n]||(q.rateValues&&q.rateValues.map(function(x){return x.text;})),b='';
      var words=!!(lab&&lab.some(function(x){return isNaN(Number(x));}));
      for(var v=lo;v<=hi;v++)b+='<button class="btn opt" data-v="'+v+'">'+esc(lab&&lab[v-lo]?lab[v-lo]:v)+'</button>';
      h+='<img class="shot" src="'+esc((md[0]&&md[0].url)||'')+'" alt="'+esc(C.alt)+'">'+
        '<div class="scale'+(words?'':' num')+'" style="--n:'+(hi-lo+1)+'">'+b+'</div>'+(words?'':'<p style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:4px"><span>'+lo+' = '+esc(q.minLabel||'')+'</span><span>'+hi+' = '+esc(q.maxLabel||'')+'</span></p>');
    }
    app.innerHTML=h+'<div class="err"></div>';
    var bs=app.querySelectorAll('[data-v]');
    bs.forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){bs.forEach(function(x){x.disabled=true;});
      var val=q.type==='imagerating'?Number(b.getAttribute('data-v')):b.getAttribute('data-v');
      SPSite.answer(n,val,{trial:k}).then(function(r){
        if(r&&r.ok===false){err(r.error);bs.forEach(function(x){x.disabled=false;});return;}
        (done[n]=done[n]||{})[k]=true;nextStep();});};});
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
  }
  function about(){
    if(!C.after.length)return finish();
    form(C.after,'About you',finish);
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you</h1><div class="card"><p>Submitting your answers…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(r&&r.ok===false){var m=r.missing||[];
      app.innerHTML='<h1>Almost done</h1><div class="card"><p>'+esc(r.error||('Please answer: '+m.join(', ')))+'</p><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="re">Go back</button></div></div>';
      document.getElementById('re').onclick=function(){if(m.indexOf('consent')>=0)return intro();start();};}});
  }
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    A=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};
    C.tasks.forEach(function(n){done[n]={};trialsOf(n).forEach(function(t,k){var v=t&&typeof t==='object'?(t.value!=null?t.value:t.answer):t;if(v!=null&&v!=='')done[n][k]=true;});});
    if(A.consent===true)start();else intro();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
